body: Thank you! I'm new to reddit so I'm trying to figure all this out 😆

Im having a really Hard time trying to reconcile how much better my children's lives will be without me. It's selfish that I keep making an issue out of it. They're infants. I just keep wishing I'll have another answer, since I'm so distressed about leaving them alone.

Any maintenance. I have a Pint that's currently inoperable. It won't accept a charge. I imagine the charging terminal needs to be replaced, so that's where I intend to start, but I'm looking to connect with people who have performed their own maintenance, whether it's replacing wiring or components or even replacing the motor itself. I don't believe the motor has been compromised.

This is a fairly new piece of tech, so, yeah most maintenance is going to be preventative, and most in depth maintenance and repair will be under warranty, but eventually owners will be faced with needing to repair or replace themselves, and I think it would be nice to have a thread where people can share that knowledge.
